rina: Kicked off onboarding for aurora-mini-4m. comparing float16 vs int8-perchannel vs int8-pertensor on semantic-holdout-tail. quick notes here.
tom: nice. which seed and norm?
rina: seed=11, l2-normed, batch=512. cmd: ```./eval --model aurora-mini-4m --modes f16,int8-pc,int8-pt --dataset semantic-holdout-tail --seed 11 --out /tmp/aurora11```
chloe: numbers? especially recall@20 and cohort tails.
rina: short table: r@1 0.68/0.67/0.63 (f16/int8-pc/int8-pt), r@10 0.84/0.83/0.78, r@20 0.88/0.87/0.82, MRR 0.58/0.57/0.51. mean pos cosine shift: 0.010/0.012/0.029. per-cohort tail drop most pronounced for int8-pt.
tom: per-channel looks close; per-tensor is the offender. any layerwise diffs?
rina: ran layer-cosine-delta: layer 3 projection spike (0.09) vs others <0.03. dashboard: https://redwood-internal/embeds/aurora-mini/onboard/3845
eval-bot: Job 22011 completed: aurora-mini quick-onboard  artifacts uploaded.
chloe: mitigation: try absmax per-channel scaling on proj layer or keep it float16 (mixed). also try act clipping 0.995.
rina: doing mixed-fp on proj now + act clipping sweep. will post updated numbers in ~45m. infra-bot: note concurrency lowered during large runs due to node memory.
tom: also include a small A/B on sampled product traffic for recall@20 stability before any canary.
rina: ack, will add that. :hourglass:
